label: Stronghold no-loss
brief: Fixed captures from the game of one catalogue subject in the meadows biome: the stronghold approach route and the hills and mountain backdrop around it (2x2: three walk views by day and a dusk vista). Judge how this subject looks in the game - whether it reads as the key art's world, with believable form, material, light and staging. Score the subject, not the rest of the frame. Wild creatures in these views vary from run to run and are not the subject.
